bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
sha=3be67d084aa7099f047d21030e5d868af02f6753
git fetch --no-tags origin "$sha" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 65
stage="$(mktemp -d)"
chmod 700 "$stage"
trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT
git show "$sha:scripts/verify_published_normal_topic_buttons.py" > "$stage/verify_published_normal_topic_buttons.py"
git show "$sha:scripts/publish_missing_normal_topic_buttons.py" > "$stage/publish_missing_normal_topic_buttons.py"
for page in 0 7 9; do
 python3 -B "$stage/verify_published_normal_topic_buttons.py" --group area --page "$page"
done
